title: HistoryGetReply
description: The parsed form of a history_get reply (a plugin's history): one property per word of the reply, a list an array, a record an object, a whole number or a decimal one a number.

history.description: The history's key=value entries; empty when it is blocked (unavailable) or has no entry.

items.title: HistoryEntry
items.description: One key=value of a plugin's history.
